verdict.rationale: Folk's pricing lists its own background capabilities: email sequences, "AI Assistants" and AI-powered custom fields, plus integrations that automatically import and sync contacts and Gmail conversations. These suggest some autonomous background behavior, but there is no documentation of a user-configurable automation or workflow builder. The REST API, webhooks and MCP server are developer building blocks or agent-driven tools, so they earn no credit here. missing for 10: documented user-defined automation rules (triggers, conditions, actions), details on what the AI Assistants do autonomously, depth on how email sequences run unattended, independent or hands-on corroboration.
